about.title: About Managing Your Files
about.intro: A simple file management platform for keeping your documents organized and easy to find.
about.whatBody: A workspace where you can upload files, browse them by type, search by name, and see useful details like size and upload date — without digging through folders.
about.whoBody: Students, freelancers and small teams who handle lots of files and want a single, clean place to keep them — without the complexity of a heavyweight document system.
about.whyBody: Most file tools are either complicated or scattered. We wanted something that gets out of your way: upload, find, done. Managing Your Files grew out of that — a focused tool that does file organization properly.
about.principle1: Simplicity first — if a feature adds friction, it does not ship.
about.principle2: Your files stay private to your account.
about.principle3: Honest about limits — no magic, no clutter.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The rules that keep Managing Your Files safe and fair for everyone.
terms.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using Managing Your Files, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for everything that happens under your account. Do not share your password or let others use your account.
terms.acceptableUseBody: Use the service lawfully. Do not attempt to access other users' files, disrupt the service, or use it to store or distribute unlawful material.
terms.contentBody: You keep full ownership of the files you upload. We do not claim any rights over your content, and we never share it with third parties.
terms.terminationBody: You may delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms, and we will remove the associated files when an account is closed.
terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from your use of the service, including loss of data. Keep backups of anything important.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Significant changes will be announced, and continued use of the service after changes take effect means you accept the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Reach out through the contact page and we will help.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the questions we hear most often.

supported.question: What file types are supported?
supported.answer: PDFs, images, text files and common data formats. If a file is one of these, you can upload and manage it.

limits.question: Is there a file size limit?
limits.answer: You can upload up to ten files at once. Each upload is subject to a per-file size limit set by the platform to keep storage reliable.

security.question: How secure is my data?
security.answer: Accounts are protected with email verification and authenticated requests. Files are only visible to their owner, and administrators do not see user file content.

deletion.question: Can I delete my account?
deletion.answer: Yes — you can request account deletion at any time. Admins can also close accounts, which removes the associated files.

retention.question: How long is my data kept?
retention.answer: Files stay in your account until you delete them or your account is closed. Removed files are purged from storage.

pricing.question: Is there a free tier?
pricing.answer: Managing Your Files is free to use while the platform is in active development. If paid plans are introduced later, we will announce them well in advance.

sharing.question: Can I share files with other people?
sharing.answer: Yes — you can share files with other users on the platform. You control whether they can only view or also edit your files.
